props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to auto-focus the first input.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Whether to auto-submit the owning form when all inputs are filled.

props.name: blurOnComplete
props.description: Whether to blur the input when the value is complete

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: count
props.description:
The number of inputs to render to improve SSR aria attributes.
This will be required in next major version.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the the pin input when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the pin input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the inputs are disabled

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the pin input. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the pin input is in the invalid state

props.name: mask
props.description: If `true`, the input's value will be masked just like `type=password`

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element. Useful for form submission.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function called on input change

props.name: onValueComplete
props.description: Function called when all inputs have valid values

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description: Function called when an invalid value is entered

props.name: otp
props.description:
If `true`, the pin input component signals to its fields that they should
use `autocomplete="one-time-code"`.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The regular expression that the user-entered input value is checked against.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text for the input

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the pin input is in the valid state

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the pin input is required

props.name: sanitizeValue
props.description:
Function to sanitize pasted values before validation.
Useful for stripping dashes, spaces, or other formatting.

props.name: selectOnFocus
props.description: Whether to select input value when input is focused

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the rendered element.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: type
props.description: The type of value the pin-input should allow

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the the pin input.
